material_claims.statement: Reported minus deducted H1 net profit equals CNY 1,973,752,934.75; financial-asset fair-value/disposal gains were CNY 2,231,404,413.90.
Storage gross margin rose from 42.84% in FY2025 to 67.57% in H1 2026, +24.73pp.
The H-share issue plus H1 share/cash position changed per-share capital structure versus FY2025.
Industry evidence supports near-term specialty-memory tightness but also potential supply response.
Post-H1 consensus already reflects elevated 2027 earnings expectations.
H1 likely combines structural product progress with a large cyclical pricing/margin component.
MCU/product breadth improves resilience but does not yet remove storage-cycle dependence.
Valuation normalizes 2027 recurring earnings below peak-H1 extrapolation using post-H-share shares.

explicit_falsifiers: Storage revenue/margin fall materially while inventory rises.
Normalized recurring earnings fall below the downside scenario despite stable unit demand.
MCU/non-memory products fail to expand economically, leaving storage concentration too high.
Post-H-share capital allocation or supply dependence reduces per-share returns without offsetting advantage.

research_snapshot.core_thesis: 兆易创新受益于成熟制程存储紧缺和产品矩阵扩张，但H1 2026高存储毛利率与部分利润来自异常周期/非经常性公允价值收益；投资价值取决于2027归一化盈利在利润率回落后能否维持，而非峰值H1线性外推。
research_snapshot.market_expectations_narrative: 后H1市场已显著上修2027盈利预期；正向差异需要高毛利持续更久或MCU/非存储增长超预期，负向差异是周期正常化快于预期。
research_snapshot.model_risk_notes: H1 2026受强存储周期和约19.74亿元非经常性损益影响；H股上市改变股本/现金基础，2027归一化利润与终值倍数高度不确定。
